sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: springsteenlyrics.com lyrics index (lyrics.php and its "Lyrics starting with" pages) is now supported, when springsteenlyrics.com support is switched on: a Lyrics button fetches every first-letter page, whichever one you start on, into one table of the over 3,500 song lines. The text in brackets is split into Type (Live, Original, Cover, Demo, Album, …), Artist, Date, Show ("early show") and No.; Lyrics says whether the song page has lyrics at all; the date is split into DD, MM, YYYY, Day and Month. The progress line names the letter it is loading, and a letter that fails to load can be resumed from that letter.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The page fetcher can now walk a list of pages named by key instead of by number (features.pageKeys, _readPageKeys()): each matching link on the page is one page, fetched by its own link, with the live page reused when its key comes up and the key list kept for a resume. Nothing on MusicBrainz uses it.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New pageType sl-lyrics (#95); fixtures sl-lyrics-{intro,paren,b}.html from debug/ snapshots via scripts/build-sl-fixtures.py (letter walls trimmed to "(" and "b"); new tests/fixtures/sl-lyrics.spec.js (7 tests incl. a resume and 42 bracket shapes); tests/live/sl-lists.spec.js checks all 32 real letters against the landing page's own per-letter counts. scripts/mutations/sl-support.json: 10 new entries. docs/claude/springsteenlyrics.md, CLAUDE.md page anatomy (pageKeys) and HELP updated.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: springsteenlyrics.com CD and vinyl bootlegs (brucelegs.php, with any letter, format or label filter) are now supported too, when springsteenlyrics.com support is switched on: a Bootlegs button fetches every page into one table with Cover, Title, Version (the pressing), Label, Cat. no., Date, First date, Show, Location and Format, plus the same date and location split as the bootleg lists. A location that is only a description ("Various Location") stays whole in Place, and "USA" reads United States.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New pageType sl-brucelegs (#94 in PAGETYPES-TESTING-REFERENCE.org); fixture pages from debug/sl-brucelegs.html via scripts/build-sl-fixtures.py; new tests/fixtures/sl-brucelegs.spec.js (5 tests); tests/live/sl-lists.spec.js gains the list and a whole-list check; sl-include-regex.spec.js covers brucelegs.php. scripts/mutations/sl-support.json: 5 new entries, one recorded as pass (the Location show note, which no fixture card has). WIP.2's location splitter learned one-part descriptions, show notes and "USA" from this list's 402 cards. docs/claude/springsteenlyrics.md and HELP updated.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com bootleg lists: the date is now also split into DD, MM, YYYY, Day and Month, and the Location into Place, Locality, Region and Country — the same columns MusicBrainz event pages get. A US show's Country reads United States (the site writes only the state), so filtering by country works. A bootleg of several shows gets one line per show in each location column. A new Show column holds the note after a date, such as "early show" or "soundcheck".

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: New ColumnDataExtractor.splitLocationText (the plain-text sibling of splitLocation, reusable by any non-MusicBrainz site) and _slShowQualifier(). tests/fixtures/sl-bootlegs.spec.js: 4 new tests plus the new headers; tests/live/sl-lists.spec.js headers. scripts/mutations/sl-support.json: 8 new entries. docs/claude/springsteenlyrics.md and HELP updated.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: jungleland.it bootleg list: a new Version column says which issue of a show each entry is (1 for the first, 2 for the site's "(Version 2)", …). It is read from the entry's link, so it is right even where the site has cut a long title off. The Date is now also split into DD, MM, YYYY, Day and Month, the same columns MusicBrainz event pages get, so you can filter for every Saturday show or every August show across the years.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: tests/fixtures/jl-list.spec.js and tests/live/jl-list.spec.js: the Date split, Version from the link (incl. a cut-off title and a named page), DD sorts numerically, _jlVersionFromHref shapes. scripts/mutations/jl-support.json: 4 new entries, two recorded as pass (the resolved-vs-written href, and DD's numeric order resting on the sort rather than integerColumns). docs/claude/jungleland.md and HELP updated.
